lots.title: (1) O'Shaughnessy Special Stock, Islay Mist & Grant's 12 Year Old BP Miniatures, 3 Bottles Sold as One Lot, Circa. 1960's-80's
lots.what_it_really_is: Three screwcap miniatures sold as one lot: O'Shaughnessy's Special Stock American Whiskey, A Blend, Eighty Proof, James Walsh & Co, Lawrenceburg, Kentucky (US blended whiskey, torn red tax strip over the gold cap); Grant's BP Best Procurable Finest Scotch Whisky 12 Years Old, black label, US proof wording, William Grant & Sons, Dufftown and Glasgow, bottled under British Government supervision; Islay Mist Scotch Whisky with a stained paper label.
lots.what_the_title_misses: Only that O'Shaughnessy's is American whiskey (not Scotch) with a US tax strip, and the condition: torn tax strip, worn and stained Islay Mist label, marked O'Shaughnessy's label, O'Shaughnessy's and Islay Mist fills at about shoulder. These are negatives or neutral facts, not hidden value. Brands, the 12 year age and BP name and the era are all already in the title.
lots.photo_evidence: Photo 1 crops read clearly: O'Shaughnessy's label (all text above legible, 'Distillers Since 1840'); Grant's label ('Grant's', 'Best Procurable BP Best Procurable', 'Finest Scotch Whisky', '12 Years Old', 'U.S. Proof', 'Distilleries Dufftown Scotland', 'Blended and bottled by William Grant & Sons Ltd', 'Distilled and bottled in Scotland under British Government supervision'). Islay Mist: only 'ISLAY MIST' and 'SCOTCH WHISKY' readable; the line under MIST, the strength and the bottler line are unreadable even enlarged, so the scan's proof and 1970s dating for this bottle are not findings. Photos 2 and 3: Grant's fill high into the lower neck; O'Shaughnessy's and Islay Mist at roughly shoulder level. Scan claims about the tax strip and label wear are confirmed.
lots.condition: O'Shaughnessy's: tax strip torn, label lightly marked, fill about shoulder. Grant's: label good for age, fill into neck. Islay Mist: label stained and worn, small print illegible, fill about shoulder. Screwcaps, so evaporation risk on the lower two.

Just Whisky lot 1330222 Islay Mist (D. Johnston, Laphroaig) 5cl 70 proof, winning bid GBP 110 no reserve, ended 17 Dec 2024 (page opened; premium not stated; NZD 260.01, AUD 208.76 at GBP 1 = NZD 2.3637 / AUD 1.8978): closest item and inside 24 months, but the Webb's Islay Mist strength and bottler line are unreadable and its label is badly stained, so same bottling and comparable condition cannot be shown. lots.guide_summary: No SOLD result for any of the three exact miniatures. Context only: a 70 proof Islay Mist 5cl made GBP 110 (about NZD 260) at Just Whisky in Dec 2024 in unknown but probably better condition; 1960s Grant's minis made GBP 35 to 40 in 2019; ordinary US blend minis make a few pounds. A fair guess for the lot is low hundreds of NZD at most, driven by the Islay Mist, but this is not supported by same-bottling SOLD data.

lots.title: (1) Ichiro's Malt & Grain 'Japan Airlines Exclusive' Single Cask Blended Whisky, Japan
lots.what_it_really_is: Ichiro's Malt & Grain Japan Airlines Exclusive, World Blended Whisky by Venture Whisky Ltd (Chichibu), 700ml, 48%, non chill-filtered, non coloured, boxed. A JAL international inflight-sales bottle; JAL's release (reported by pontospravoar.com) describes it as a blend of about 20 whiskies, average over 10 years old, sold at JPY 20,000 from about September 2025.
lots.what_the_title_misses: The title adds 'Single Cask', which is not on the front or back label, no cask or bottle number appears, and the release information describes a multi-whisky blend. The back label's Japanese origin line reads 英国製造、国内製造 (made in the UK and in Japan), confirming a world blend with imported components. Neither point adds value; the single cask claim inflates it.
lots.photo_evidence: Photo 1: front label fully legible: 'Ichiro's Malt & Grain, Japan Airlines Exclusive, This whisky is blended by Ichiro Akuto, founder of the Chichibu Distillery... This is World Blended Whisky. Non Chill-filtered, Non Coloured, 700ml 48%vol'. Box front matches. Photo 2: back label fully legible: '48% ALC. by VOL 700ml, Ingredients: Malt, Grain', US Government Warning, 'Produced by: Venture Whisky Ltd, 49 Midorigaoka, Chichibu-shi, Saitama, Japan', Japanese text including 原料原産地名: 英国製造、国内製造 (モルトウイスキー), barcode 4 580617 291061. Photo 3: black tape seal intact with a small lifted or creased edge at the lower rim; fill at the base of the neck, good. Scan claims confirmed; its 2018-2022 era guess is not supported (JAL release points to 2025).
lots.condition: Fill base of neck (good), boxed, black tape seal with a minor crease or lift at the lower edge, labels clean.

lots.guide_summary: No auction result found for the JAL Exclusive itself. It cost JPY 20,000 (about NZD 225) new on JAL flights in late 2025, and a Japanese buy-back shop offered JPY 28,000 (about NZD 316) in May 2026. The regular Malt & Grain Limited Edition last sold for GBP 50 (about NZD 118) in April 2025. Realistic value is roughly the original retail, NZD 200-320, not a single-cask premium.
